description: Water flow routes over land (Urban Forest) is a dataset listed in City of Melbourne Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. These flow routes are derived from the 2008 DEM surface using ESRI Spatial Analyst stream order tool with STRAHLER ordering. The GRIDCODE field represents stream order. Lines with no tributaries are assigned an order of one and are referred to as first order. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal files it under Environment. Its keywords are flow routes, flows, rivers, #urbanforest, urban forest, water. The portal shows 7,701 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-02-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melbourne-vic-gov-au-portal.
